trust_decision.summary: POST /update decides which caller-supplied top-level config keys may be merged into the global config_data. Before the fix it uses a denylist (task_plugins_config_default, api_token), so a token holder can overwrite 'webui' (the credentials that derive the login/API token) and any other key.

landing_point.why: The advisory names POST /update. The denylist loop is the whole handler.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site and no O8 route. The only other config writer, /api/add_task (app/run.py:479), appends to 'tasklist', which the fix allowlists anyway.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The web UI posts the whole formData from GET /data back to /update. That body includes api_token and task_plugins_config_default (added by /data), and the SKILL client posts partial bodies such as just {tasklist}. A fix that rejects unknown keys, rather than silently dropping them, or that drops 'cookie', 'plugins', 'source' or 'push_config', breaks saving.

O6_input_shapes: top-level JSON object keys only (the fix flips a denylist to an allowlist of 7 keys); no nested or array variant handled

O8b_injection_room.sibling: /api/add_task could gain a 'config' or settings merge that copies request keys into config_data the same way /update does
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: add_task already writes caller JSON into config_data and persists it with Config.write_json. A maintainer adding 'update settings via API' would likely copy the /update loop.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The plugin task_after hook returns a dict that is copied into CONFIG_DATA (tasklist, plugins[name]); generalising it to merge arbitrary returned keys would be a distant second writer
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already writes CONFIG_DATA['tasklist'] and CONFIG_DATA['plugins'][name] from plugin output, and a generic key loop is a natural extension. It is plugin-sourced rather than HTTP-sourced, so it is weak as a mass-assignment sibling.

O9_family: CWE-915 mass assignment of config keys (credential overwrite via denylist)

O10_build.project_tests: none found (no test files in the pinned tree)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add 'webui' to dont_save_keys (denylist extension) instead of switching to an allowlist.
